Q9033.reason: VCLT Article 31 requires good-faith interpretation by the ordinary meaning of the terms in context and in light of the treaty’s object and purpose; preparatory works are only a supplementary means under Article 32.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is an excessive firm mass of scar tissue growing beyond the original wound; a fine hairline scar is the opposite, and early drain removal does not define a keloid.

Q9037.reason: A standard indication for tracheostomy is prolonged ventilation and weaning from a ventilator; it does not repair paralyzed vocal cords and is not routinely done merely before neck surgery.
